summary.text: Dick Fascia is a Republican state representative who has represented District 42 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 7, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Fascia was born in Providence, Rhode Island, graduated from Hope High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Roger Williams University in 1992.
His career experience includes working as a police officer, a fraud investigator and a human resources manager.
